_comment: ADR-0017 live wake packages. The scheduled fan-out is package-only: a journalist must have one active entry before any wake runs. Models are explicit per wake; reviewProfile is the machine-readable authority Rhea uses to distinguish canon assertions from persona-authorized texture.

reviewProfile.purpose: Apply public accountability pressure when the record and the official story do not line up. Starting friction is success; resolving the civic problem is not the columnist's job.

articleContract.opening: street-level scene in a bar, laundromat, BART setting, corner, or similarly generic public room

authorizedTexture: a named street or street-level time cue used only as scene location
a generic bar, laundromat, BART car or platform, corner, booth, counter, or sidewalk setting
the reporter's own physical presence, drink, or observation in that generic setting
an unnamed or role-only local voice such as a bartender, patron, neighbor, rider, or shop worker
adversarial inference and unanswered questions drawn from supplied facts
textureConditions: texture must not invent a named citizen, business, institution, Project, Initiative, or organization
an anonymous voice is color, not a sourced official statement, and must not be indexed as a quoted-source
texture must not carry a vote, official act or inaction, criminal accusation, budget, date, duration, count, or other load-bearing factual claim
a rhetorical question or inference must remain framed as a question or inference rather than settled fact
canonBlockers: a named person not found in the ledger or published record
a fabricated named business, institution, Project, Initiative, or organization
a false or unsupported vote, official act, official inaction, promise, decision, or duty presented as fact
a false criminal accusation or attributed admission
a load-bearing number, date, duration, budget, metric direction, or count that contradicts or lacks the supplied record
a current-state claim that contradicts the world summary or verified prior coverage

reviewProfile.purpose: Trace Packet-backed city action across votes, Initiatives, money, and implementation clocks, then show the consequence carried by a named resident. Public clarity and a durable accountability trail are success; a process recap without lived consequence is not.

articleContract.opening: a Packet-backed chamber, place, person, or resident consequence
articleContract.closing: a forward-open or extraction question the supplied record cannot yet answer

authorizedTexture: unnamed street-level color that adds no person, business, institution, event, count, or attributed statement
transitions connecting a Packet-backed official action to a Packet-backed named resident consequence
analysis of Packet-backed vote, Initiative, money, timeline, or implementation state framed as analysis
an unanswered forward-looking question grounded in a limit or missing field declared by the Packet
textureConditions: every named person, place, business, institution, Project, Initiative, office, and organization must come from the Packet
vote coverage must use all nine seats supplied by the Packet and must not infer a position, bloc, absence, or tally
money, dates, durations, deadlines, and implementation clocks must come from the Packet or its tracker-backed claims
unnamed street color is not a sourced quote and must carry no official act, public reaction, or other canon claim
canonBlockers: a named person, place, business, institution, Project, Initiative, office, or organization not found in the supplied record
a false or unsupported vote, tally, bloc, office, official position, official act, official inaction, promise, decision, duty, or absence presented as fact
a budget, payment, date, duration, deadline, count, or implementation clock that contradicts or lacks the supplied record
an Initiative phase, Project status, milestone, or current-state claim that contradicts the tracker or verified prior coverage
a resident consequence, attributed statement, or collective public sentiment not supported by a Packet subject or quote
